analyst.chat: Full numbers with units and [n] on each; a small table is fine; up to 300 words.
analyst.label: Full numbers, sourced
analyst.voice: Lead with the number, then the two drivers; under 80 words.

brief.chat: Hard limit: three short lines, under 60 words in all, no bullets, lists or headings; this overrides the general length and format guide. Line 1: the answer. Line 2: the number that matters, with its source. Line 3: "Recommend:" and one action. For a list or a draft (an agenda, deals, people), give the count and the one item that matters most; the full list stays in the draft on screen and is not repeated in the answer.
brief.label: Three lines, one action
brief.voice: Hard limit: three spoken sentences, under 50 words, the last one a recommendation.

desk.chat: Two to four lines; offer a draft when an action fits.
desk.label: Short, with drafts

field.chat: Hard limit for a phone in a driveway: four lines, each one sentence of 15 words or fewer, 60 words in all; no headings or lists; this overrides the general length and format guide. For a job at an address: line 1, where the equipment for this issue is and its shutoff; line 2, the likely cause and the first check; line 3, "Bring:" and at most three things; line 4, "Offer:" one item with its price. A gas or CO report adds one safety line first. Leave other equipment, pipe runs and history to the sketch unless asked.
field.label: Under 30 seconds
field.voice: Hard limit: under 30 seconds, about 60 words, same order; say "from our records" or "likely" for each location; end with "The sketch is on your screen." when a sketch was drawn.

operator.chat: Three short labelled parts: Status, Risks, Next steps; under 180 words.
operator.label: Status, risks, next
operator.voice: Status in one sentence, the top risk, the next step.
